propositions: rebar's LLM runtime treats all providers as Anthropic-shaped in practice, with provider-specific branching on anthropic prefix strings scattered across multiple modules
AWS Bedrock-hosted Anthropic Claude is unsupported despite being the primary deployment path for rebar's clients, requiring either a proxy gateway or direct BedrockConverseModel integration
documentation already claims base_url and api_key support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, but _pai_check_config actively refuses these configurations with LLMConfigError

pydantic-ai's provider_factory extension point and ModelProfile capability override mechanism enable first-class Bedrock and best-effort OpenAI-compatible support without provider-name string matching

prompt caching and retry/timeout behavior differ between Bedrock (boto3/botocore client) and direct Anthropic (httpx transport), requiring provider-specific capability declarations and retry/timeout configuration per transport

signed verdict sidecars must record structured provenance including provider name, endpoint host, support tier, and effective capabilities so consumers can distinguish first-class from best-effort LLM calls
